Resizes pending_ids_ to the number of nodes in the graph view.
Reads the send_device attribute from the node into a string.

states.claim: The frame info's nodes field is assigned a newly allocated vector of NodeItem pointers.
root_frame_info_ is set to the FrameInfo pointer for the empty frame name.
pending_ids_ is resized to the number of nodes in the graph view.
item points to the NodeItem for the current node id in the graph view.
item->kernel is set to nullptr when kernel creation fails.
item->kernel is checked to be non-null.
const_tensor points to the kernel's constant tensor, which may be null.
const_tensors_ holds a shallow copy of the constant tensor.
item->const_tensor is set to the kernel's constant tensor pointer.
frame_info points to the FrameInfo for the enter node's frame name.
enter_frame_info_[id] is set to the frame_info pointer.
pending_ids_[id] is set to a pending count handle created with max_pending and max_dead.
outputs_required owns a newly allocated bool array of size n->num_outputs().
item->outputs_required takes ownership of the outputs_required array.

values.claim: pending_ids_ is resized to gview_.num_nodes(), so valid indices into pending_ids_ are 0..gview_.num_nodes()-1.
frame_name is the element of cf_info.frame_names at index id, where id = n->id().
values.evidence:
L39: const int id = n->id();
L40: const string& frame_name = cf_info.frame_names[id];

values.claim: item->input_start is assigned the current value of frame_info->total_inputs before total_inputs is incremented.
values.evidence:
L46: item->input_start = frame_info->total_inputs;
L47: frame_info->total_inputs += n->num_inputs();

values.claim: If enter_frame_info_.size() <= id, enter_frame_info_ is resized to id + 1, so after this point enter_frame_info_ has size at least id + 1.
pending_ids_[id] is assigned the handle created by frame_info->pending_counts_layout.CreateHandle(max_pending, max_dead).
outputs_required points to a newly allocated bool array of length n->num_outputs().
The range [&outputs_required[0], &outputs_required[n->num_outputs()]) is filled with false.
outputs_required is indexed by e->src_output() when e->src_output() >= 0.
unused_outputs is decremented when an output is first marked required.
The loop iterates i from 0 while i < n->num_outputs().
dst_item is the NodeItem returned by gview_.node(dst_id), where dst_id = e.dst_id.
values.evidence:
L169: const int dst_id = e.dst_id;
L170: NodeItem* dst_item = gview_.node(dst_id);
